characters.name: SIIL SIIM
characters.description: Väike pruun siil pehmete okastega, seljas väike roheline särk. Suured rõõmsad silmad ja sõbralik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: HIIR HELEN
characters.description: Väike hall hiir suurte roosade kõrvadega, seljas väike kollane kleit. Teravad uudishimulikud silmad ja naeratav nägu. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: KÖÖK
locations.description: A cozy and bright kitchen with light yellow walls and a checkered floor. A simple wooden table is in the center with two small chairs. A window on the back wall shows a sunny green garden outside. There are a few simple wooden cabinets on the wall. Warm, inviting atmosphere. Cartoon style.

locations.name: NIIT
locations.description: A beautiful sunny summer meadow with lush green grass and a few colorful wildflowers scattered around. A gentle blue sky with fluffy white clouds overhead. A few distant trees are visible at the edge of the meadow. Bright, cheerful, and peaceful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.text: SIIL SIIM JA HIIR HELEN ON KÖÖGIS.
pages.scene: Siil Siim, a small brown hedgehog wearing a green shirt, and Hiir Helen, a small gray mouse wearing a yellow dress, are standing in a cozy and bright kitchen. They are looking at each other with happy smiles. The kitchen has light yellow walls, a checkered floor, and a simple wooden table with two chairs. A window shows a sunny green garden outside. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are still in the cozy kitchen, standing near the wooden table. They are both smiling brightly, looking excited and gesturing slightly with their paws as if discussing a fun idea. The kitchen has light yellow walls, a checkered floor, and a window showing a sunny green garden outside. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are at the wooden table in the cozy kitchen. Siil Siim is holding a piece of bread and a small knife (blunt, child-safe) spreading something on it. Hiir Helen is arranging small pieces of cheese and cucumber on other bread slices, making sandwiches. They are focused and happy. The kitchen has light yellow walls, a checkered floor, and a window showing a sunny green garden outside. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are still in the cozy kitchen. Siil Siim is carefully holding a small, colorful bottle of juice. Hiir Helen is looking at the bottle and smiling. The wooden table is nearby, and the kitchen has light yellow walls, a checkered floor, and a window showing a sunny green garden outside. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are packing a picnic basket on the wooden table in the cozy kitchen. Siil Siim is placing the freshly made sandwiches into the basket, while Hiir Helen is putting the juice bottle inside. The basket is a classic woven picnic basket. They look happy and busy. The kitchen has light yellow walls, a checkered floor, and a window showing a sunny green garden outside. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are walking across a beautiful sunny summer meadow. Siil Siim is carrying the picnic basket. Hiir Helen is walking beside him, looking ahead excitedly. The meadow has lush green grass and a few colorful wildflowers. A blue sky with fluffy white clouds is visible. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are in the sunny summer meadow. Siil Siim is carefully laying out a colorful picnic blanket on the lush green grass. Hiir Helen is helping to spread it, both smiling. The picnic basket is on the grass nearby. Colorful wildflowers dot the meadow. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are sitting on their colorful picnic blanket in the sunny summer meadow. They are happily eating the sandwiches they made. The picnic basket is open beside them. They are both smiling, enjoying their meal. Lush green grass and colorful wildflowers surround them. Cartoon style.

Siil Siim and Hiir Helen are sitting on the colorful picnic blanket in the sunny summer meadow. They are finished with their picnic and are looking at each other, laughing and smiling brightly. The empty picnic basket is next to them. The sun is shining, and wildflowers are all around them. Cartoon style.
